phase: Phase 5 development stress tests and analysis freeze
stress_fit_scope: models and preprocessing fit on frozen training rows only; perturbations applied to calibration predictors only
learned_gate_scope: nonnegative reliability weights fit from training OOF prediction errors only; calibration outcomes are evaluation-only
threshold_selection: calibration reliability quantiles at 100%, 90%, and 80%; no calibration-outcome threshold optimization
subgroup_policy: prespecified aggregate groups with minimum n=20 and minimum events=5; no patient-level tracked output
tracked_outputs: aggregate metrics, figures, audits, immutable config hashes, sealed cohort set digests, and receipt only
